kv_footprint.method: ctypes on the pinned bundle; KV = VmRSS delta across llama_init_from_model (kv_unified=True); prefill = one llama_decode of a 217-token shared prefix; warm decode = median of 5 single-token decodes
kv_footprint.finding: with kv_unified=True the measured KV is identical for n_seq_max=1 and 4: the cache is n_ctx cells shared by every sequence, exactly as S-4 hypothesised. The conservative planner charges n_ctx * n_seq_max, i.e. 4x too much at n_seq_max=4, and agrees with the measurement to 0.1% at n_seq_max=1. The recommender stays conservative (S-4) until E2.5 consumes this number.
kv_footprint.secondary: llama.cpp splits this arch into a SWA cache (27 layers) + a non-SWA cache (9 layers): at n_ctx=2048/f16 that is 216 MiB + 72 MiB = 288 MiB, matching the 302 MB measured (decimal).

mutation_round_2.environment_caveat: this container shares a 256-pid cgroup with sibling cards; a sibling Stryker (node) run plus mutmut's 8 workers killed two full-scope runs mid-flight with `BlockingIOError: [Errno 11]` in os.fork() and a third needed max_children=2. The scores above are from the cache that survived; `not_checked` mutants are simply not part of the denominator (mutmut's exit_code_by_key).

e2e_findings_t_3831b7b3.severity: P3 (tooling, out of the card's scope)
e2e_findings_t_3831b7b3.what: `docs/verify_runtime_contract.py::find_runtime()` resolves $GGUFONE_RUNTIME_DIR -> $XDG_DATA_HOME/ggufone/runtime -> ~/.local/share/ggufone/runtime and never consults $GGUFONE_HOME, while the product resolves $GGUFONE_HOME first (registry/store.py). With the operator layout (GGUFONE_HOME=~/.hermes) the gate's step-8 oracle reports 'SKIP no runtime installed' right after init installed one (gate2), and tools/live_probe.py resolves the model as $GGUFONE_HOME/models else ~/.hermes/models so the --run-network model tests fail when the store is not ~/.hermes (gate3: 2 failed).
e2e_findings_t_3831b7b3.repro: bash tools/host_gate_e1a.sh with GGUFONE_HOME=$HOME/.hermes -> oracle.steps skipped; or see .e2e/t_3831b7b3-host-gate/logs/gate2|gate3
e2e_findings_t_3831b7b3.suggest: have the oracle use ggufone.registry.store.data_home() (or export GGUFONE_RUNTIME_DIR in the gate script for step 8) and pin the model path rule in one place

e2e_findings_t_3831b7b3.what: On a fresh box without the pinned 4.4 GB model, the gate is red: pytest_after fails `test_oracle_live_section_is_green_without_skips` (section B model check SKIPs) and pytest_network too; the host passes only because the model is already in ~/.hermes/models.
e2e_findings_t_3831b7b3.repro: .e2e/t_3831b7b3-host-gate/logs/gate1 (no model) -> pytest_after exit 1, 'section B skipped: [...] Spark-X2.5-4B-Q8_0.gguf absent'
e2e_findings_t_3831b7b3.suggest: state the model as a gate precondition in the script header, or skip that assertion with an explicit reason when the model is absent

e2e_findings_t_3831b7b3.what: `GGUFONE_HOME=/proc/ggufone-cannot-write uv run ggufone init` -> exit 4 with 'error: E_INTERNAL: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: /proc/ggufone-cannot-write'
e2e_findings_t_3831b7b3.suggest: map an uncreatable data home to a named error (e.g. E_DATA_HOME_UNWRITABLE) with the path in the message

e2e_findings_t_3831b7b3.what: `models pull '🔥not/a-repo:Q9_9'` -> exit 3 with "E_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: 🔥not/a-repo: 'ascii' codec can't encode character '\U0001f525'" - a Python codec error leaking into user output
e2e_findings_t_3831b7b3.suggest: validate the repo ref (charset) before the request and report E_INVALID_REPO with the raw value
